body.prompt: An 8K resolution, photorealistic industrial design rendering of a quadcopter with a wide X-shaped layout, 30cm rotor-to-rotor distance, 1.3:1 arm span ratio, 52° rotor angle, streamlined fuselage, 80cm wing curvature radius, 60° fuselage edge angle, foldable arms, carbon fiber frame, ABS propellers with nano-coating, anodized aluminum honeycomb grille, cold grey color scheme, blue LED light band, reinforced motor covers, modular quick-release connectors, and a GPS antenna discreetly integrated into the top surface, all highlighted under a 90° overhead view with soft 5500K lighting and high-contrast shadows. Picture 1 is a top-view plan of the airframe skeleton at the same scale and framing as the output image: four arms and four motor mounts. Keep every motor mount and every arm where it is in Picture 1. The fuselage, the propellers and all other parts are not in the plan; design them from the description. Do not keep the flat grey shapes.
